source: Merged from research/profile-packs (Kimi K3, Astra, Fable). Single source of truth for the intake picker, the kit (KIT_PACKS) and the CRM.
approval_line: Your assistant drafts. You approve before anything is sent, posted, shared, bought or published. We never read your email inbox.
change_line: Change your picks any time by texting your assistant.

included.name: Included with every plan
items: Your prices, answers and the way you write
Notes, memory and a Monday plan

segments.name: Office or professional services
segments.hint: Accounting, consulting, clinics' front office, small firms

segments.name: Something else
segments.hint: We will suggest a starting set

packs.name: Front Desk
packs.promise: Fast, friendly replies and follow-ups in your voice, so no lead or quote goes cold.
examples: Reply to this text from Mrs. Diaz about the leak
Follow up on the Hendersons' quote from Tuesday
Confirm tomorrow's 9am with a friendly reminder

segment_extras.insurance: Renewal check-ins and certificate request replies

packs.approvals: Drafts only. You send. No coverage promises or fair-housing risks in drafts.

packs.name: Get Paid
packs.promise: Quotes, job write-ups and polite payment reminders, ready for you to send.
examples: Turn these notes into a quote
Write up today's job at 14 Oak St
Draft a polite reminder for invoice 203, 10 days late
packs.approvals: No access to your bank or payment apps. Amounts come from you.

packs.name: Reviews and Google
packs.promise: Answer every review and keep your Google listing fresh.
examples: Write a Google post about our fall tune-up special
Text asking Mr. Lee for a review
packs.approvals: You paste and post. Nothing is posted for you.

packs.name: Paperwork Desk
packs.promise: Turns documents, meetings and receipts into clear summaries, files and to-do lists.
examples: What does this contract make me do and by when?
Build a spreadsheet from these receipts
Turn my meeting notes into a to-do list with dates
packs.approvals: Summaries are not legal advice and are labeled that way.

packs.name: Marketing Studio
packs.promise: Posts, flyers, short videos and website updates, approved by you first.
examples: Three Facebook posts for this week
A 30-second video explaining our drain service
packs.approvals: Nothing goes public without your yes.

packs.name: Dashboards and Tools
packs.promise: Ask for a tracker or dashboard by text and get a clean, private one built for your work.
examples: Make me a board of open quotes and who to call back
Track my jobs this week on my phone
Show money in and out by week
packs.approvals: It asks a few questions, shows a plan and a screenshot, and only goes live after your yes.
